void aes_encrypt_block(uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *in, const uint32_t *rk, int nr) {
    uint8_t state[16];
    load_block(state, in);
    for (int round = 0; round < nr; ++round) {
        add_round_key(state, rk + round * 4);
        sub_bytes(state, sbox);
        shift_rows(state);
        if (round != nr - 1) {
            mix_columns(state, gf_mul);
        }
    }
    add_round_key(state, rk + nr * 4);
    store_block(out, state);
}
